## Ngjyrat e dritareve: e bardhë, antracit apo dekor druri? | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/blog/ngjyrat-e-dritareve-dhe-dyerve/

Kreu
Blog
Cilën ngjyrë të zgjidhni për dritaret: e bardhë, antracit apo dekor druri?

Zgjedhja e produktit

Cilën ngjyrë të zgjidhni për dritaret: e bardhë, antracit apo dekor druri?

Nga ekipi i Apex Frames · 31 tetor 2026 · 4 min lexim

Imazh ilustrues

Përgjigje e shkurtër Për PVC ofrohen e bardha, dekor druri, e zeza (Jet Black) dhe antracit, edhe me ngjyrë të ndryshme brenda e jashtë. Për aluminin ka gamë të gjerë RAL dhe imitacione druri. Zgjidhni sipas fasadës, grilave dhe pamjes së brendshme, dhe kërkoni mostra para porosisë.

Në këtë artikull
Ngjyrat sipas materialit
Si ta harmonizoni me fasadën
Mostra dhe vizualizime
Pyetje para se të vendosni
Pyetje të shpeshta

Ngjyrat sipas materialit
Produkti Ngjyrat

Dritare dhe dyer PVC E bardhë, dekor druri, e zezë (Jet Black), antracit; ngjyrë e ndryshme brenda dhe jashtë

Dritare dhe dyer alumini Gamë e gjerë RAL dhe imitacione druri

Dyer me panel PVC P.sh. antracit, me përmasa sipas porosisë

Grila persiane alumini Ngjyra standarde dhe speciale RAL

Si ta harmonizoni me fasadën
E bardha: zgjedhje klasike që përshtatet me shumicën e fasadave.
Antracit dhe e zezë: pamje moderne dhe kontrast i fortë me muret e çelëta.
Dekor druri: ngrohtësi, sidomos në shtëpi me gjelbërim.
Brenda e jashtë: mund të zgjidhni ngjyrë të ndryshme, p.sh. antracit jashtë dhe e bardhë brenda.
Aksesorët: grilat, rrjetat dhe tendat zgjidhen në ngjyrën që përputhet me profilin; shih tendat dhe grilat .

Mostra dhe vizualizime
Ofrojmë mostra ngjyrash dhe vizualizime, që ta shihni zgjedhjen para prodhimit. Ngjyrat e errëta nxehen më shumë në diell; pyesni për sistemin e zgjedhur nëse dritaret janë shumë të ekspozuara.

Pyetje para se të vendosni
A i keni parë mostrat e ngjyrës në dritë natyrale?
A doni ngjyrë të ndryshme brenda dhe jashtë?
A përputhen grilat, rrjetat dhe tendat me ngjyrën e profilit?
A është fasada shumë e ekspozuar ndaj diellit?

Pyetje të shpeshta
A mund të ketë dritarja ngjyrë të ndryshme brenda e jashtë?
Po, për dritaret PVC mund të zgjidhet ngjyrë e ndryshme nga brenda dhe nga jashtë.
A ka ngjyra RAL?
Po, për aluminin ofrojmë gamë të gjerë RAL dhe imitacione druri.
A ofrohen dritare të zeza?
Po, për dritaret PVC ofrohet ngjyra e zezë (Jet Black), së bashku me të bardhën, dekorin e drurit dhe antracitin.
A ofrohen dyer antracit?
Po. Dyert me panel PVC ofrohen në antracit dhe finitura me dekor druri; shih katalogun e dyerve hyrëse.

## Fasada xhami curtain wall: çfarë të dini | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/blog/fasada-xhami-curtain-wall-cfare-duhet-te-dini/

Kreu
Blog
Fasada xhami (curtain wall): çfarë duhet të dini para projektit

Standarde dhe dokumente

Fasada xhami (curtain wall): çfarë duhet të dini para projektit

Nga ekipi i Apex Frames · 31 tetor 2026 · 5 min lexim

Imazh ilustrues

Përgjigje e shkurtër Një fasadë curtain wall është një strukturë alumini me termoizolim dhe xham që mbulon fasadën e ndërtesës dhe nuk mban peshën e saj. Prodhohet sipas projektit të arkitektit, me përmasa, ndarje dhe ngjyra RAL të personalizuara dhe me xham termik, stop-sol ose të laminuar.

Në këtë artikull
Çfarë përfshin
Zgjedhja e xhamit
Çfarë i duhet arkitektit
Si ecën procesi
Pyetje për furnizuesin
Pyetje të shpeshta

Çfarë përfshin
strukturë alumini me termoizolim;
xham dopio, termik, stop-sol (kontroll diellor) ose i laminuar;
përmasa dhe ndarje sipas projektit të arkitektit;
ngjyra RAL të personalizuara;
rezistencë ndaj motit dhe izolim nga zhurma, me vlera sipas dokumentacionit të sistemit.

Zgjedhja e xhamit
Xhami Përdoret kur

Dopio termik Kërkohet izolim termik

Stop-sol Fasada merr shumë diell dhe duhet kontroll diellor

I laminuar Kërkohet siguri: shih laminuar apo i kalitur

Çfarë i duhet arkitektit
Për specifikim ofrojmë skeda teknike dhe dokumentacion të sistemit (DoP, CE), mostra ngjyrash dhe vizualizime. Mësoni si lexohen në DoP dhe shenja CE .

Si ecën procesi
Konsulencë teknike dhe përzgjedhje e sistemit sipas objektit.
Vizitë teknike dhe matje në terren.
Fletë specifikimi, e miratuar para prodhimit.
Prodhim sipas specifikimit të miratuar dhe transport.
Montim, kontroll final dhe procesverbal dorëzimi.

Pyetje për furnizuesin
Cili sistem alumini propozohet dhe ku janë skedat teknike dhe DoP?
Cili xham përdoret: termik, stop-sol apo i laminuar?
Si miratohet specifikimi para prodhimit?
Kush koordinon montimin me strukturën e ndërtesës?

Pyetje të shpeshta
A është curtain wall vetëm për ndërtesa komerciale?
Jo. Fasadat zbatohen për objekte banimi, biznese dhe qendra tregtare.
A punoni sipas projektit të arkitektit?
Po. Fasadat prodhohen sipas projektit, dhe ju ofrojmë dokumentacionin për specifikim.
A mund të ketë fasada ngjyra RAL të personalizuara?
Po, ofrojmë ngjyra RAL të personalizuara për fasadat.
A përfshihet transporti?
Transporti deri në objekt, në Tiranë dhe në qytete të tjera, është pjesë e shërbimit tonë.

## Si të zvogëloni zhurmën nga rruga me dritare akustike | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/blog/si-te-zvogeloni-zhurmen-nga-rruga-me-dritare/

Kreu
Blog
Si të zvogëloni zhurmën nga rruga me dritare të reja

Këshilla

Si të zvogëloni zhurmën nga rruga me dritare të reja

Nga ekipi i Apex Frames · 31 tetor 2026 · 4 min lexim

Imazh ilustrues

Përgjigje e shkurtër Izolimi nga zhurma varet nga katër gjëra: xhami (akustik ose i laminuar), guarnicionet dhe profili, montimi hermetik dhe ajrimi. Vlera Rw në deklaratën e performancës tregon izolimin: sa më e lartë, aq më pak zhurmë kalon. Një dritare e hapur ose me çarje e anulon efektin.

Në këtë artikull
Çfarë ndikon në izolimin akustik
Si lexohet vlera Rw
Çfarë të pyesni para porosisë
Gabime të shpeshta
Pyetje të shpeshta

Çfarë ndikon në izolimin akustik
Xhami: xhami akustik është i ndërtuar posaçërisht për zhurmën; xhami i laminuar ndihmon gjithashtu.
Profili dhe guarnicionet: mbyllja e rreptë pengon kalimin e zërit.
Montimi: çarjet rreth kornizës lejojnë zhurmën; izolimi perimetral me PU dhe silikoni cilësor i mbyllin.
Ajrimi: dritarja e hapur nuk izolon aspak.

Si lexohet vlera Rw
Rw është vlera e izolimit akustik të dritares, e shprehur në decibel dhe e dhënë në deklaratën e performancës (DoP). Sa më e lartë vlera, aq më mirë izolon. Krahasoni vetëm vlera nga DoP e sistemit të plotë (profil + xham). Mësoni më shumë te DoP dhe shenja CE .

Çfarë të pyesni para porosisë
cili xham akustik propozohet dhe cila është vlera Rw e sistemit;
si bëhet montimi dhe mbyllja perimetrale: shih montimin në 8 hapa ;
çfarë mundësish ka për ajrim kur dritaret mbahen të mbyllura.

Gabime të shpeshta
Supozimi se dritarja e re e zgjidh zhurmën edhe me montim të dobët.
Krahasimi i dritareve pa vlerën Rw nga DoP.
Harrimi i ajrimit: një dritare e hapur e anulon izolimin.

Pyetje të shpeshta
A mjafton xhami dopio për zhurmën?
Varet nga situata. Për rrugë me zhurmë ekziston xhami akustik; vlerat konkrete jepen në deklaratën e performancës.
A ndikon montimi në zhurmë?
Po. Çarjet rreth kornizës lejojnë kalimin e zhurmës, prandaj izolimi perimetral dhe silikoni ndikojnë në rezultat.
Çfarë është Rw?
Rw është vlera e izolimit akustik të dritares, në decibel, e dhënë në deklaratën e performancës. Sa më e lartë, aq më pak zhurmë kalon.
A mjafton ndërrimi i xhamit?
Xhami është vetëm një faktor: profili, guarnicionet dhe montimi hermetik ndikojnë gjithashtu në rezultat.

## Rrjeta kundër insekteve: cilin model? | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/blog/rrjeta-kunder-insekteve-cilin-model-te-zgjidhni/

Kreu
Blog
Rrjeta kundër insekteve: cilin model të zgjidhni për derë ose dritare

Zgjedhja e produktit

Rrjeta kundër insekteve: cilin model të zgjidhni për derë ose dritare

Nga ekipi i Apex Frames · 31 tetor 2026 · 4 min lexim

Imazh ilustrues

Përgjigje e shkurtër Për dyer ballkoni zgjidhen zakonisht rrjetat plissé (me palosje) ose ato rrëshqitëse; për dritare, rrjetat vertikale me rrotullim ose të fiksuara në kornizë. Rrjeta është prej fiberglassi ose poliesteri me mbrojtje anti-UV, dhe sistemi plissé modular ka nga 1 deri në 4 fletë.

Në këtë artikull
Llojet kryesore
Materiali dhe detajet
Çfarë të pyesni para porosisë
Gabime të shpeshta
Pyetje të shpeshta

Llojet kryesore
Lloji Si funksionon Më i përshtatshëm për

Rrëshqitëse horizontale Rrëshqet në shina Dritare dhe dyer me hapësirë anash

Vertikale me rrotullim Rrotullohet dhe mbështillet në një kuti Dritare

Të fiksuara në kornizë Montohen në kornizë dhe qëndrojnë në vend Dritare ku rrjeta nuk lëvizet shpesh

Plissé (me palosje) Palosen si fizarmonikë Dyer ballkoni dhe hapje të mëdha

Materiali dhe detajet
Rrjeta: prej fiberglassi ose poliesteri, me mbrojtje anti-UV.
Sistemi plissé modular: ka nga 1 deri në 4 fletë, sipas gjerësisë së hapjes.
Prag i ulët (3–7 mm) te dyert, për akses pa pengesa.
Aksesorë cilësorë me frenues magnetik.

Çfarë të pyesni para porosisë
cili model përshtatet me derën ose dritaren tuaj (shih edhe llojet e dyerve rrëshqitëse );
sa hapësirë ka anash për rrjetën kur hapet;
sa i ulët është pragu te dera;
cila ngjyrë përputhet me profilin e dritares ose derës.

Gabime të shpeshta
Zgjedhja e modelit pa matur hapësirën anash.
Mospërfillja e pragut te dyert.
Zgjedhja e një ngjyre që nuk përputhet me profilin.

Pyetje të shpeshta
Cili model është më i mirë për derë ballkoni?
Për dyer përdoren zakonisht modelet plissé ose rrëshqitëse. Modelin e zgjedhim sipas hapjes dhe hapësirës anash gjatë vizitës teknike.
A ka prag të ulët te dyert?
Po, sistemi plissé për dyer ka prag të ulët (3–7 mm) për akses pa pengesa.
A ka rrjeta për dritare dhe për dyer?
Po. Ofrojmë modele rrëshqitëse, vertikale me rrotullim, të fiksuara në kornizë dhe plissé, për dyer dhe dritare.
A mund të vendos rrjetë në dritare ekzistuese?
Varet nga dritarja dhe modeli; e vlerësojmë gjatë vizitës teknike.

## Kangjella me xham, inox dhe alumin | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/blog/kangjella-me-xham-cfare-duhet-te-dini/

Kreu
Blog
Kangjella me xham, inox dhe alumin: çfarë të dini para porosisë

Zgjedhja e produktit

Kangjella me xham, inox dhe alumin: çfarë të dini para porosisë

Nga ekipi i Apex Frames · 31 tetor 2026 · 4 min lexim

Imazh ilustrues

Përgjigje e shkurtër Kangjellat me xham e mbrojnë ballkonin, tarracën ose shkallën pa e prerë pamjen. Struktura bëhet prej inoksi ose alumini dhe xhami është sigurie, i laminuar ose i kalitur. Prodhohen sipas matjeve në terren; lartësinë dhe kërkesat e sigurisë i përcakton projekti dhe rregullat e ndërtimit.

Në këtë artikull
Inoks apo alumin
Xhami i sigurisë
Si ecën porosia
Çfarë të pyesni
Gabime të shpeshta
Pyetje të shpeshta

Inoks apo alumin
Kriteri Inoks Alumin

Pamja Metalike e pastër E lehtë, përputhet me dritaret dhe dyert prej alumini

Kur zgjidhet Kur doni një detaj metalik të dukshëm Kur doni unitet me fasadën prej alumini

Xhami I njëjti xham sigurie, i laminuar ose i kalitur, në të dyja rastet

Xhami i sigurisë
Panelet përdorin xham sigurie. Dallimin mes xhamit të laminuar dhe të kalitur e shpjegojmë te xham i laminuar apo i kalitur . Xhami i kalitur nuk pritet pas kalitjes, prandaj matjet duhet të jenë të sakta para prodhimit.

Si ecën porosia
Vizitë teknike dhe matje në terren.
Fletë specifikimi, e miratuar para prodhimit.
Prodhim sipas specifikimit dhe transport.
Montim, kontroll final dhe procesverbal dorëzimi.

Çfarë të pyesni
cila lartësi dhe cilat kërkesa sigurie kërkohen nga projekti ose nga rregullat e ndërtimit (pyesni projektuesin);
cili xham sigurie propozohet;
cila ngjyrë ose finiturë ka struktura;
si fiksohet struktura në ballkon ose në dysheme.

Gabime të shpeshta
Porosia pa matje në terren.
Xham pa siguri te parapetet.
Injorimi i rregullave të ndërtimit për lartësinë: pyesni projektuesin.
Mos koordinimi me dyert dhe dritaret e ballkonit.

Pyetje të shpeshta
A është xhami i sigurisë i detyrueshëm?
Kjo varet nga projekti dhe rregullat e ndërtimit, prandaj pyesni projektuesin. Ne prodhojmë parapete me xham sigurie, të laminuar ose të kalitur.
Si matet kangjella?
Matjet merren në objekt nga ekipi teknik dhe specifikimi miratohet para prodhimit.
A prodhohen sipas projektit të arkitektit?
Po. Kangjellat dhe parapetet prodhohen sipas matjeve në terren dhe projektit arkitektonik.
A mund të përdoren edhe në shkallë?
Po, kangjellat zbatohen për ballkone, tarraca dhe shkallë, në ambiente banimi dhe biznesi.

Të ngjashme

Kangjella inox, alumini & xhami
Xhama
Dyer hyrëse & automatike

Nga blogu

Xhama · 4 min lexim
Xham i laminuar apo i kalitur? Cili është më i sigurt
Dallimi mes xhamit të laminuar (triplex) dhe të kalitur, ku përdoret secili në dyer, parapete dhe dritare dhe pse përmasat duhen të sakta para porosisë.

Çmimet dhe oferta · 5 min lexim

8 faktorët që përcaktojnë çmimin e dritareve PVC dhe alumini, si t’i krahasoni dy oferta drejt dhe çfarë mund të mos përfshihet.

Keni një projekt në mendje?

## Politika e Privatësisë | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/privatesia/

Kreu
Politika e Privatësisë
Apex Frames SHPK
Politika e Privatësisë
Përditësuar më 2 nëntor 2026

Kjo politikë shpjegon si Apex Frames SHPK (NUIS M62116046U), me seli në Innovation Hub, Piramida e Tiranës, Bulevardi "Dëshmorët e Kombit" 5, Tiranë ("ne"), përpunon të dhënat personale kur vizitoni www.apexframes.co ose na kontaktoni. Përpunimi bëhet në përputhje me Ligjin nr. 124/2024 "Për mbrojtjen e të dhënave personale".

1. Kontrolluesi i të dhënave

Kontrollues është Apex Frames SHPK. Për çdo pyetje: info@apexframes.co · +355 69 888 1333.

2. Çfarë të dhënash mbledhim

Të dhëna që na jepni vetë kur na shkruani me email, telefon, WhatsApp ose përmes formularit: emër, kompani, email, telefon, përshkrim i projektit dhe adresa e objektit.

Të dhëna kontraktuale kur bëheni klient: të dhënat e faturimit, matjet, specifikimet, kontratat dhe korrespondenca.

Kërkesa për certifikatë garancie (faqja Certifikata e garancisë ): asnjë fushë personale nuk është e detyrueshme . Mund të jepni emrin, mbiemrin, emailin, telefonin, produktin, datën e blerjes dhe referencën e kontratës ose faturës; duhet të jepni vetëm të paktën një detaj që ta verifikojmë blerjen. Ne ruajmë vetëm çfarë jepni. Pas miratimit ruhen edhe numri i certifikatës dhe datat e garancisë.

Faqja nuk përdor cookies gjurmuese, mjete analitike ose reklama. Formulari i kontaktit nuk ruan të dhëna në serverin tonë: ai thjesht përgatit një email në aplikacionin tuaj, të cilin ju vendosni ta dërgoni. Ndryshe nga ai, formulari i certifikatës së garancisë i ruan të dhënat që plotësoni në sistemin tonë (hostuar në Netlify), me qëllim shqyrtimin e kërkesës dhe lëshimin e certifikatës. Për mbrojtje nga abuzimi përdorim një shenjë të koduar (hash) të adresës IP, jo vetë IP-në, dhe e ruajmë vetëm për kohë të shkurtër. Kodi i kërkesës që merrni nuk përmban të dhëna personale.

Kontrolli publik i certifikatës (me numrin AF-…) tregon vetëm inicialet e mbajtësit, datat dhe statusin; emri i plotë, emaili dhe telefoni nuk shfaqen.

3. Pse i përpunojmë dhe baza ligjore

Për t'iu përgjigjur kërkesës suaj dhe për të përgatitur ofertën — hapa para lidhjes së kontratës, me kërkesën tuaj.

Pëlqimi juaj për të dhënat që plotësoni vullnetarisht te kërkesa për certifikatë garancie. Mund ta tërhiqni pëlqimin në çdo kohë (info@apexframes.co), pa cenuar ligjshmërinë e përpunimit që ka ndodhur më parë; pas miratimit, ruajtja e certifikatës mbështetet te përmbushja e detyrimit tonë të garancisë ndaj jush.

Për zbatimin e kontratës: matje, prodhim, montim, dorëzim dhe garanci, përfshirë shqyrtimin e kërkesës dhe lëshimin e certifikatës së garancisë.

Për detyrime ligjore, si faturimi i fiskalizuar dhe ruajtja e dokumenteve financiare.

Për interes legjitim: mbrojtja e të drejtave tona dhe trajtimi i ankesave.

4. Me kë i ndajmë

Nuk i shesim të dhënat tuaja. Mund t'i ndajmë vetëm me sa është e nevojshme me furnizues dhe transportues për realizimin e porosisë, me ofruesit e shërbimeve të email-it dhe hostimit, me kontabilistin, ose me autoritetet kur kërkohet me ligj. Të gjithë veprojnë me marrëveshje të shkruar dhe detyrim konfidencialiteti.

Transferime jashtë Shqipërisë. Sistemi i certifikatave hostohet te Netlify, Inc. (SHBA), dhe emailet automatike (nëse aktivizohen) dërgohen përmes një ofruesi të emailit. Të dhënat mund të ruhen ose përpunohen jashtë Shqipërisë. Këto transferime mbështeten te marrëveshja e përpunimit të të dhënave e ofruesit dhe klauzolat standarde kontraktuale që ajo përfshin. Faqja nuk transferon të dhëna te rrjetet sociale pa veprimin tuaj.

5. Sa kohë i ruajmë

Kërkesat që nuk kthehen në kontratë ruhen deri në 12 muaj. Kërkesat për certifikatë që nuk miratohen (në pritje ose të refuzuara) fshihen automatikisht pas 12 muajsh. Certifikatat e lëshuara ruhen gjatë periudhës së garancisë (5 vite); 12 muaj pas skadimit, të dhënat personale fshihen ose anonimizohen dhe mbeten vetëm numri, datat dhe statusi, pa asnjë të dhënë personale. Mund të kërkoni fshirjen më herët. Dokumentet kontraktuale dhe financiare ruhen të paktën 5 vjet, sipas legjislacionit fiskal shqiptar.

6. Të drejtat tuaja

Keni të drejtë të kërkoni akses, korrigjim, fshirje, kufizim të përpunimit, transferim të të dhënave, të kundërshtoni përpunimin dhe të tërhiqni pëlqimin e dhënë. Na shkruani në info@apexframes.co ; përgjigjemi brenda 30 ditëve. Keni gjithashtu të drejtë të ankoheni te Komisioneri për të Drejtën e Informimit dhe Mbrojtjen e të Dhënave Personale (idp.al).

7. Siguria

Zbatojmë masa teknike dhe organizative të arsyeshme: akses i kufizuar vetëm për personelin e autorizuar, komunikim nga adresa zyrtare e kompanisë dhe arkivim i strukturuar i dokumenteve. Paneli i brendshëm i certifikatave mbrohet me fjalëkalim dhe qasja kufizohet te personeli i autorizuar. Në rast shkeljeje të të dhënave që sjell rrezik, e njoftojmë Komisionerin brenda 72 orëve dhe, kur rreziku është i lartë, edhe personat e prekur.

8. Ndryshimet

Mund ta përditësojmë këtë politikë. Versioni në fuqi është gjithmonë ai i publikuar në këtë faqe, me datën e përditësimit.

Your partner for frames that last.

Our vision
To become the leading name in the Albanian market for advanced and sustainable frame systems — setting a new benchmark in quality and reliability for residential and commercial spaces.

Our promise
At the heart of our work is partnership. We believe in long-term relationships built on trust, consistency and shared success — for builders, architects, developers and homeowners alike.

Trusted European quality
Every product ships with the manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE marking under EN 14351-1. We quote technical values only from official documentation — never approximations.

Quality
No compromise on materials, installation or service.

Clear communication, deadlines met, commitments honoured.

Final prices, written terms, no hidden costs.

We keep our word. If there is an obstacle, we tell you — with a solution.

## PVC (uPVC) Windows and Doors in Tirana, Albania | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/pvc-upvc-windows-doors/

Home
Products
PVC (uPVC) windows & doors

Products

PVC (uPVC) windows and doors

Short answer PVC (uPVC) windows are the most common choice for homes and offices: good thermal and acoustic insulation, minimal maintenance and a wide range of openings and colours. Apex Frames supplies and installs them with the manufacturer’s documentation.

uPVC profiles contain a steel reinforcement. Build depth varies by system (70, 76 or 82 mm), and glazing can be double or triple, with argon gas, Low-E or laminated glass.

What’s included

Side-hung, tilt & turn, fixed and multi-sash
Bathroom and utility windows
Special shapes, including arched
Entrance and balcony doors
Sliding doors: lift & slide, sliding and PSK
White, woodgrain, black (Jet Black) and anthracite; different colour inside and outside

Best for

Apartments and private homes
Offices and budget-conscious projects
Renovations that need better insulation

How to choose PVC windows
Before ordering, decide four things: the profile system (build depth is 70, 76 or 82 mm depending on the system), the glazing (double or triple, with argon, Low-E or laminated), the opening type and the colour . Compare thermal and acoustic insulation only by the values in the Declaration of Performance (DoP) of the complete system, not brochures or verbal promises.
Installation matters as much as the profile: PU perimeter insulation and quality silicone sealing directly affect the real result. Read PVC or aluminium: how to choose , what affects the price and why windows sweat .

Frequently asked questions

Are uPVC windows durable?
Yes, when they come from a certified system and are installed correctly. The profile has a steel reinforcement, and our warranty is 5 years on the product (per the manufacturer) and 24 months on installation.
Which colours can I choose?
White, woodgrain, black (Jet Black) and anthracite. The window can have a different colour inside and outside.
How well do uPVC windows insulate?
It depends on the system and glazing you choose and is stated in the manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP). You can request it before ordering.
Which documents do I get with PVC windows?
At handover you receive the manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE marking, the warranty certificate, the maintenance guide and the handover protocol.
Do you remove the old windows?
Yes. Removing the existing product and cleaning the opening are part of the installation procedure, and you can request them in the quote.

## Thermally Broken Aluminium Windows and Doors, Tirana | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/aluminium-windows-doors/

Home
Products
Thermally broken aluminium

Products

Thermally broken aluminium windows and doors

Short answer Thermally broken aluminium is the answer for large openings, slim profiles and commercial buildings: high structural strength and a wide RAL colour range. The insulating break inside the profile reduces energy loss compared with plain aluminium.

Aluminium systems suit projects that need large glass areas, sliding doors or a minimalist look. Thermal and acoustic values come from the Declaration of Performance of the selected system.

What’s included

Standard, tilt & turn and sliding openings
Balcony doors with thermal break
Entrance doors for heavy loads and high traffic
Panoramic systems and folding (bi-fold) doors
Plain aluminium for fixed panels and partitions, including mirrored double glazing
Wide range of RAL colours and wood finishes

Best for

Large openings and panoramic views
Businesses, hotels and high-traffic buildings
Minimalist designs with slim profiles

How to choose aluminium windows and doors
Thermally broken aluminium is chosen when you want large openings , slim profiles or a high-traffic building. Check the system and available series from the manufacturer, the Uw value in the DoP, the glass type and the colour (RAL or wood effect).
For projects with an architect or builder we provide technical sheets, DoP and CE, colour samples and alternative quotes for different systems. See what a thermal break is and sliding door types .

Frequently asked questions

Aluminium or uPVC: which should I choose?
uPVC is usually more economical and very good for homes; aluminium allows larger openings and slimmer profiles. Read our detailed comparison on the blog.
What is a thermal break?
An insulating separator inside the aluminium profile that interrupts heat flow from inside to outside and vice versa.
Do you offer RAL colours?
Yes, we offer a wide range of RAL colours and wood-effect finishes.
Which documents do I get with aluminium windows?
The manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE marking, the warranty certificate, the maintenance guide and the handover protocol.
Do you work with builders and architects?
Yes. We collaborate with construction companies, developers and architects, with technical documentation, written lead times and on-site coordination.

## Entrance, Panel and Automatic Doors in Tirana | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/entrance-automatic-doors/

Home
Products
Entrance & automatic doors

Products

Entrance, panel and automatic doors

Short answer Doors for homes, businesses and public buildings, in uPVC or aluminium: single or double leaf, made-to-order panels or sensor-operated automatic doors.

The door is the first point of contact with your building. We select the material, opening, glass and hardware for the use: home, shop, clinic or public entrance.

What’s included

uPVC and aluminium entrance doors, single or double leaf
PVC panel doors (e.g. anthracite), made to size
Automatic doors with sensor and professional automation system
Laminated (triplex) or tempered safety glass
Left or right opening, defined from outside; each leaf can open differently
Locks, handles and hardware to suit the building

PVC entrance doors catalogue Browse 58 panel models in the T, I and F series, with or without a side panel. View the catalogue

Best for

Business, shop and clinic entrances
Residential buildings with shared entrances
Private homes with custom design

How to choose an entrance door
Decide the material (PVC or aluminium), panel or glass, left or right opening and the type of safety glass. The opening is defined by looking at the door from outside and confirmed on the specification sheet before manufacture.
For PVC panel doors you can choose from our catalogue of 58 models . For busy business entrances, an automatic sensor door is the most practical solution. Read how to choose an entrance door .

Frequently asked questions

How is left or right opening defined?
It is defined by looking at the door from outside, and we confirm it on the specification sheet before manufacture. Each leaf of a double door can open differently.
Can doors have safety glass?
Yes. Laminated or tempered safety glass is selected according to the building and your requirements.
Can I order a door from the catalogue?
Yes. Pick the model in the catalogue and send us its code (e.g. T17); after measurement you receive a quote with a final price.
What warranty do the doors have?
5 years on the product (per the manufacturer’s certification) and 24 months on installation, from the handover protocol.

## Aluminium Glass Curtain Wall Facades in Albania | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/glass-facades/

Home
Products
Glass facades

Products

Glass facades (curtain wall)

Short answer Curtain walls are insulated aluminium structures with glazing that cover a building facade. They are built to the architect’s design, with custom dimensions, divisions and RAL colours.

For modern buildings the facade is both image and performance. We work with architects and builders to turn the design into a buildable system.

What’s included

Insulated aluminium structure
Double, thermal, solar-control (stop-sol) and laminated glass
Dimensions and divisions per the architect’s design
Custom RAL colours
Weather resistance and sound insulation; values per the system documentation
For residential, commercial and retail buildings

Best for

Office buildings and shopping centres
Glazed entrances and facades on residential buildings
Projects with an architect and technical specification

How a facade project runs
A curtain wall facade starts with the architect’s design. We help with system selection, technical sheets and documentation (DoP, CE), colour samples and visualisations. After on-site measurement a specification sheet is prepared and approved before production; then come manufacturing, delivery, installation and final inspection.
Glass is chosen by function: thermal, solar-control (stop-sol) or laminated. See what to know before the project and laminated or tempered .

Frequently asked questions

Do you work to the architect’s design?
Yes. Facades are fabricated to the project, and we provide technical sheets and system documentation for specification.
Which glass is used in facades?
Per the project: thermal double glazing, solar-control glass or laminated glass.
Do you provide documentation for architects?
Yes. We provide technical sheets, the Declaration of Performance (DoP), the manufacturer’s CE marking, colour samples and visualisations for specification.
How does specification approval work?
After on-site measurement a specification sheet is prepared and production starts only once you approve it.

## Double, Triple, Laminated and Acoustic Glass | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/glazing/

Home
Products
Glazing

Products

Glazing for windows, doors and facades

Short answer Glass makes up most of a window, so it directly affects thermal insulation, noise, safety and light. We supply made-to-order glazing: double, triple, laminated, tempered, acoustic and Low-E.

The right glass depends on location, orientation and use. Concrete values are given in the Declaration of Performance of the complete system (profile + glass).

What’s included

Thermal double glazing (e.g. 4-16-4, 4-20-4) with argon
Thermal triple glazing (e.g. 4-16-4-16-4)
Laminated (triplex) and tempered safety glass
Acoustic glass
Low-E, Four Seasons and solar-control glass
Mirrored double glazing for fixed panels; colours: clear, grey, bronze, blue

Best for

Noisy streets: acoustic glass
Balconies and doors: tempered or laminated glass
Strong sun exposure: solar-control glass
Cold rooms: triple glazing or Low-E

How to choose glazing
Choose glass by the problem you want to solve: thermal insulation (double or triple with argon and Low-E), noise (acoustic glass), safety (laminated or tempered) or strong sun (solar control). Ug and Uw values are read from the Declaration of Performance, and tempered glass cannot be cut after tempering, so dimensions must be exact before production.
Read double or triple glazing , laminated or tempered and how to reduce street noise .

Frequently asked questions

Double or triple glazing?
Triple insulates better but is heavier and costs more; double glazing with argon and Low-E is often enough for homes. See our detailed article.
What does Low-E mean?
A very thin, invisible coating on the glass that reflects part of the heat, reducing winter heat loss.
Do you replace damaged glass?
Yes. Replacing damaged glass is part of our after-sales service, with a prior quote.
Do you offer acoustic glass?
Yes, acoustic glass is part of our range, along with double, triple, Low-E, solar-control, laminated and tempered glass.

Products
Shutters & roller blinds

Products

Louvred, strap-operated and motorised shutters

Short answer Shutters and roller blinds provide shade, privacy and security for windows and doors. We offer aluminium louvred shutters, strap-operated shutters (PVC or aluminium) and motorised shutters with remote control, even for large openings.

Shutters fit uPVC and aluminium windows; we confirm compatibility during the technical visit. For motorised shutters, the motor is selected according to weight and size.

What’s included

Aluminium louvred shutters, fixed or opening
Strap-operated shutters with outside or inside box, PVC or aluminium
Motorised shutters with remote; user guide at handover
Reinforcement parts for large sizes
Standard and special RAL colours
External roller blinds, manual or motorised

Best for

Apartments wanting shade and privacy
Homes with large openings: motorised shutters
Tight budgets: strap-operated shutters

How to choose shutters and roller blinds
Decide from the start how it will be operated (strap or motor), the type of box (outside or inside), the material (PVC or aluminium) and the colour. An outside box allows quick installation and easy access; an inside box gives a cleaner look on the facade. For large openings, the motor is selected by weight and size and reinforcement parts are added.
See strap or motorised shutters and window and door colours .

Frequently asked questions

Strap-operated or motorised?
A strap is simple and economical; a motor with remote is more comfortable, especially for large or hard-to-reach openings.
Do they fit existing windows?
Shutters fit uPVC and aluminium windows; we confirm compatibility during the technical visit.
Are external roller blinds available?
Yes, we offer external roller blinds, manual or motorised.
Do I get a guide for the remote?
Yes, for motorised shutters we provide a remote-control user guide at handover.

URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/insect-screens/

Home

Insect screens

Products

Insect screens (fly screens)

Short answer Insect screens let you ventilate without mosquitoes and other insects. We offer horizontal sliding, vertical roll-up, fixed-frame and pleated (plissé) models for windows and doors.

The right model depends on the opening and the space to the side. We assess it during the technical visit.

What’s included

Horizontal sliding
Vertical roll-up
Fixed frame
Pleated (plissé) screens for doors and windows
Mesh in fibreglass or polyester with UV protection
Modular plissé system with 1 to 4 leaves
Low threshold (3–7 mm) for barrier-free access on doors
Quality hardware with magnetic catch

Best for

Balcony doors left open in summer
Bedroom windows
Areas with many insects

How to choose an insect screen
Choose the model by the opening: plissé or sliding for doors, vertical roll-up or fixed-frame for windows. The mesh is fibreglass or polyester with UV protection; the modular plissé system has 1 to 4 leaves and, on doors, a low threshold (3–7 mm) for barrier-free access.
See insect screens: which type and sliding doors .

Frequently asked questions

Which model suits a balcony door?
Sliding or pleated (plissé) models are usually used for doors; we choose according to the opening and the space to the side.
Can I add a screen to an existing window?
It depends on the window and the model; we assess it during the technical visit.
What material is the mesh?
The mesh is fibreglass or polyester with UV protection.
Can it be combined with sliding doors?
Yes, we offer sliding and plissé screens for doors; we choose the model according to the space to the side.

Products

Awnings, marquees and pergolas

Short answer Awnings and pergolas create shade and comfort for balconies, terraces and hospitality spaces. We offer manual or motorised awnings and aluminium pergolas, with or without canopy, to your project.

Strong aluminium structure and UV-certified fabric, in cassette and classic models.

What’s included

Manual or motorised awnings
Cassette and classic models
UV-certified material
Strong aluminium structure
Aluminium pergolas, with or without canopy, to project

Best for

Large terraces and balconies
Restaurants, cafés and hotels
Homes with a yard

How to choose an awning or pergola
Assess the terrace orientation, the wall or structure the awning attaches to and the area to cover. Choose between a cassette (protects the fabric when retracted) and a classic model, between a manual mechanism and a motor, and the fabric colour. Retract the awning in strong wind. For large spaces, an aluminium pergola with or without a canopy is the alternative.
See cassette or classic awning .

Frequently asked questions

Cassette or classic awning?
The cassette protects the fabric when the awning is retracted; classic models are simpler. We choose according to placement and exposure.
Is the fabric sun-resistant?
Yes, we use UV-certified material.
Do you offer motorised awnings?
Yes, we offer manual or motorised awnings, in cassette and classic models.
What is the structure made of?
The structure is strong aluminium, and the fabric is UV-certified material.

## Stainless, Aluminium and Glass Railings in Tirana | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/products/stainless-aluminium-glass-railings/

Home
Products
Stainless, aluminium & glass railings

Products

Stainless, aluminium and glass railings

Short answer Railings (balustrades) protect balconies, terraces and stairs without blocking the view. We make railings in stainless steel and aluminium, with laminated or tempered safety glass, to on-site measurements and the architectural design.

Railings combine a stainless-steel or aluminium structure with glass panels. Height and safety requirements are set by the project and building rules; we manufacture to the approved specification.

What’s included

Railings and balustrades with safety glass, laminated or tempered
Structure and handrails in stainless steel or aluminium
Open view: glass preserves the view from the balcony or terrace
Fabricated to on-site measurements and the architect’s design
For balconies, terraces, stairs and residential and commercial spaces
Installation coordinated with doors, windows and facades

Best for

Balconies and terraces with a view
Indoor and outdoor stairs
Restaurants, hotels and commercial spaces

How to choose glass railings
Decide the structure material (stainless steel or aluminium), the type of safety glass (laminated or tempered) and how it is fixed to the balcony or floor. Height and safety requirements are set by the project and building rules: ask your designer. Measurements are taken on site, and tempered glass cannot be cut after tempering.
See glass railings: what to know and laminated or tempered glass .

Frequently asked questions

Which glass is used in railings?
Laminated or tempered safety glass, according to the project and your requirements. See our article on the difference between them.
Are they made to size?
Yes, they are made to on-site measurements and the architectural design; the specification is approved before production.
Stainless steel or aluminium?
Stainless steel gives a clean metallic look; aluminium matches aluminium windows and doors well. The choice depends on design, setting and budget.
Does it combine with aluminium doors and windows?
Yes, installation is coordinated with the project’s doors, windows and facades.
How does the order work?
Technical visit and measurement, specification approved before production, manufacturing, installation and handover protocol.

## Our Process: From Survey to Handover | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/process/

Home
Process

Process

How we work

Every project follows the same documented steps. Work starts only with a signed contract — so you always know what you get, when, and what you pay.

01 Contact
Email or call us. We reply within 24 hours.

02 Survey & measure
Our technical team assesses the site, takes measurements and discusses design and performance goals.

03 Quotation
Within 48 hours you receive a detailed quote with specifications, lead times and payment terms.

04 Agreement
Confirmed in writing. Any change is documented by addendum — nothing verbal.

05 Production & installation
Built to spec and installed in 8 steps: fixing, PU insulation, sealing, adjustment and clean-up.

06 Inspection & handover
Final inspection of every unit, signed handover protocol and the start of your warranty.

Our timelines

Reply to your request
24 hours

Quote after site visit
48 hours

Quote validity
30 days

Claim acknowledgement
24 hours

Want the installation details?

How installation works, step by step

What happens at each step
Contact. We register your request and reply within 24 hours; phone calls are always confirmed in writing.
Visit and measurement. Our technical team assesses the building, measurements and product type, and completes the measurement form and position specification.
Quotation. Within 48 hours of the visit you receive the quote with a final price, technical specifications, lead time and payment terms. The quote is valid for 30 days.
Agreement. Work does not start without a contract signed with the General Terms and, where applicable, confirmation of the deposit. Every change is documented by addendum.
Production and installation. Installation follows 8 steps: preliminary inspection, removal, frame fixing, PU perimeter insulation, silicone sealing, mechanical adjustment, final inspection and clean-up. See installation in 8 steps .
Inspection and handover. After the final inspection both parties sign the handover protocol; the final invoice is issued after it and the warranty starts.

Warranty

Warranty

Warranty and after-sales service

The warranty starts from the date of the handover protocol, signed by both parties.

Support that doesn’t end at delivery.

5 yrs Product warranty
Per the manufacturer’s certification, from the date of the handover protocol.

24 mo Installation warranty
Covering installation work, from the date of the handover protocol.

24h Claim acknowledgement
Every claim is acknowledged in writing and handled under a clear procedure.

Warranty types

Type Duration Starts
Product warranty 5 years, per the manufacturer’s certification From the handover protocol
Installation warranty 24 months From the handover protocol
Statutory consumer guarantee 2 years for conformity of goods From delivery

For consumers, the contractual warranty does not affect the statutory 2-year conformity guarantee under Albanian Law No. 9902/2008 on Consumer Protection. The warranty does not cover misuse, accidental mechanical damage, unauthorised alterations or damage from extreme weather.

How a claim is handled

01 Acknowledgement
Confirmed in writing within 24 hours.

02 Investigation
Within 48 hours the cause is analysed and the situation documented.

03 Resolution
A concrete solution is offered within 5 working days. The warranty is activated when the claim is justified.

04 Closure
The solution is documented and client satisfaction confirmed in writing.

Documents you receive at handover
Manufacturer’s DoP and CE marking
Warranty certificate
Maintenance guide
Handover protocol

Online warranty certificate
Request your certificate with a unique number and check the 5-year warranty term at any time.

What the warranty covers and what it doesn’t
The warranty covers product and installation defects within the periods above. It does not cover misuse, accidental mechanical damage, unauthorised alterations or damage from extreme weather.
How to request warranty service
Write to info@apexframes.co or call us, with the document number (e.g. the contract) and a description of the problem.

## Online Warranty Certificate and Validity Check | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/warranty/certificate/

Home
Warranty
Warranty certificate

Warranty certificate

Online warranty certificate

Request the 5-year warranty certificate for the product you bought from Apex Frames. After our team verifies it you receive a unique number (AF-…), and you can check the warranty term online at any time.

Warranty certificate

01 Fill in the request
First name, last name, email and phone. The more purchase details you give, the faster it is verified.

02 We verify and approve
Our team checks the purchase and issues the certificate with a unique number, valid for 5 years from the purchase date.

03 Get your certificate
Use the request code to download the PDF. Anyone can check the term online with the AF-… number.

Check validity or status

Enter the certificate number (e.g. AF-0005657) or the request code (RQ-…).

Check

Certificate request

No field is mandatory: give only what you wish. Please fill in at least one detail so we can verify the purchase (e.g. the invoice number or your name). Without an email, you see the request code only on screen: keep it.

First name (optional) Last name (optional)

Email (optional) Phone (optional)

Product (optional)
Purchase or installation date (optional) Contract or invoice no. (optional)

Website

I consent to the details I filled in being stored to review the request and issue the certificate. I can withdraw my consent at any time, as set out in the Privacy Policy .
How we use your data. The controller is Apex Frames SHPK. We use it only to review the request and to issue and manage the warranty certificate. Unapproved requests are deleted after 12 months; the certificate is kept during the warranty. You can request access, correction or erasure at any time at info@apexframes.co. Details: Privacy Policy .

Send request

Certificate questions

How long is the warranty?
The warranty covers material and manufacturing defects for 5 years from the purchase date. The certificate shows the start date and the expiry date.
What does it cover and what not?
The service includes repair or replacement of the product at no extra cost to the client. The warranty applies only if the product was used according to instructions; it does not cover misuse, accidents, extreme weather and unauthorised alterations; transport and installation costs are not included.
Who approves the certificate?
Requests are reviewed and approved by the Apex Frames team. Only after approval is the AF-… number and the PDF certificate issued.
What does the public check show?
Anyone with the AF-… number sees only the holder’s initials, start date, expiry date and status. The full name, email and phone are never shown.
I lost my request code. What do I do?
Write to info@apexframes.co with the details you gave in the request (e.g. the invoice number, name or email) and we will help you.
Can I have my data deleted?
Yes. Write to info@apexframes.co and we delete the personal data (name, email, phone, reference). The certificate stays valid, because the number, dates and status are kept without any personal data so the online check keeps working.
Do I have to give my name, email or phone?
No, none of them is mandatory. You only need to give at least one detail so we can verify the purchase, e.g. the invoice number. The less data you give, the less we store.

## PVC and Aluminium Windows FAQ | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/faq/

Home
FAQ

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can’t find your answer? Write to us and we’ll reply within 24 hours.

How is the site survey arranged?
After first contact we book a confirmed appointment. Our technical team visits the site, takes measurements and assesses the right product type.
How quickly will I get a quote?
A detailed quote is sent within 48 hours of the site survey and remains valid for 30 days from issue.
uPVC or aluminium — what’s the difference?
uPVC offers excellent thermal insulation at a lower cost and is ideal for homes. Thermal aluminium allows slimmer profiles, larger openings and RAL colours — preferred for facades, sliding doors and commercial buildings. We help you choose based on the building, budget and design.
How do payments work?
For supply, typically a 50% deposit on signing and 50% before delivery. For supply with installation, 50% deposit and 50% after handover. All payments are made by bank transfer to the company account, as set out in the contract.
Do you install products bought elsewhere?
Yes. We also offer installation, removal or sealing as a standalone service when the client supplies the product.
Do you work outside Tirana or abroad?
Yes. We deliver and install across Albania, and prepare quotes for international clients in English or Italian, priced in EUR.
Are prices final?
Yes. A quote contains a final price with no hidden costs. Apex Frames is not VAT-registered.
Which documents do I receive at handover?
The manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE marking, the warranty certificate, the maintenance guide and the handover protocol.
How long is the warranty?
5 years on the product (per the manufacturer’s certification) and 24 months on installation, from the handover protocol. Consumers also keep their statutory guarantee.
How are claims handled?
A claim is acknowledged in writing within 24 hours, analysed within 48 hours and a solution offered within 5 working days.
What if I change something after the quote?
Every change to the original quote is documented by a contract addendum. Verbal changes are not accepted.
Do you work with builders and architects?
Yes. We collaborate with construction companies, developers, architects and resellers across Albania, with technical documentation, written lead times and on-site coordination.
Can I get a quote in English or Italian?
Yes. For international clients we prepare quotes in English or Italian, priced in EUR with delivery terms stated.
What is usually not included in a quote?
The cost of structural demolition or civil works outside the scope of installation, client-supplied materials, and customs duties or specific local taxes, which are listed separately where they apply.

Tell us about your building and we’ll reply within 24 hours.

How the sandwich panel is built

The panel has an XPS (extruded polystyrene) core, faced with a bonded PVC sheet and a protective film. Woodgrain finishes add a laminated foil.

Protective film
Laminated foil for woodgrain finishes
PVC sheet
Adhesive
XPS core (extruded polystyrene)

Catalogue questions

How do I order a model from the catalogue?

Which colours are available?
Models are shown in white, and the panel is also available in Golden Oak, Nussbaum, Mahogany and Anthracite finishes.
How is the door panel built?
It is a sandwich panel with a protective film, PVC sheet, adhesive and XPS core; woodgrain finishes add a laminated foil.
Can the doors be made to size?
Yes, PVC panel doors are made to size, confirmed on the specification sheet before production.

## uPVC or Aluminium Windows? How to Choose the Right One | Apex Frames

uPVC or Aluminium Windows? How to Choose the Right One

Choosing products

uPVC or Aluminium Windows? How to Choose the Right One

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 5 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Choose uPVC when you want good insulation at a lower cost for homes. Choose thermally broken aluminium when you need large openings, slim profiles or a commercial building. Both are long-lasting when certified and properly installed.

In this article
Side-by-side comparison
When to choose uPVC
When to choose aluminium
What matters more than the material
Common mistakes when choosing
Frequently asked questions

Side-by-side comparison
Criteria uPVC Thermally broken aluminium

Thermal insulation Very good; value per DoP Very good with thermal break; value per DoP

Profile Thicker Slimmer, more glass

Large openings Possible with lift & slide systems Ideal for panoramic and large sliding doors

Colours White, woodgrain, black, anthracite Wide RAL range and wood finishes

Maintenance Minimal Minimal

Cost Usually more economical Usually higher

When to choose uPVC
uPVC is the usual choice for apartments and houses: good insulation, simple maintenance and a reasonable price. It also suits renovations aimed at better comfort and insulation.

When to choose aluminium
Aluminium is chosen for large openings, sliding or folding doors, or a minimalist look with slim profiles. It is also common in businesses, hotels and facades.

What matters more than the material
Two windows of the same material can perform very differently. Check:
The profile system and number of air chambers;
The glass : double or triple, Low-E, argon;
Installation : perimeter insulation and sealing determine real-world results;
The manufacturer’s DoP with certified values.

Common mistakes when choosing
Choosing by price alone, without comparing the profile system and glass.
Comparing values from brochures instead of the Declaration of Performance (DoP).
Ignoring installation: a good window badly installed loses performance.
Plain aluminium for heated rooms: it is meant for fixed panels and partitions, not ordinary windows.

Frequently asked questions
Which is more durable: uPVC or aluminium?
Both are long-lasting when they come from a certified system and are installed correctly. Our warranty is 5 years on the product and 24 months on installation.
Which insulates better?
There is no single answer: insulation depends on the system, the glass and the installation. Compare the Uw value in each system’s Declaration of Performance.
Can I combine PVC and aluminium in the same building?
Yes. PVC is often used for rooms and aluminium for large openings or sliding doors; each position is specified separately.
Does the warranty differ by material?
Our warranty is 5 years on the product (per the manufacturer’s certification) and 24 months on installation.

What Affects the Price of Windows and Doors?

Pricing and quotes

What Affects the Price of Windows and Doors?

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 5 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Price depends on the profile system, size, glazing, opening type, colour, hardware and installation. Two quotes compare fairly only when they specify the same elements. Apex Frames gives no verbal prices: the price is written only in the detailed quote, after measurement.

In this article
The 8 main factors
How to compare two quotes
What may not be included
How to get an accurate quote
Mistakes when comparing quotes
Frequently asked questions

The 8 main factors
Profile system (uPVC or aluminium, build depth, number of chambers).
Dimensions : area in m² and number of sashes.
Glazing : double or triple, Low-E, acoustic, laminated, tempered.
Opening type : fixed, tilt & turn, sliding, lift & slide.
Colour : white, woodgrain, RAL, different colour inside and out.
Hardware : mechanisms, handles, locks, shutters, screens.
Installation and removal of existing windows.
Transport and site location.

How to compare two quotes
Ask each quote to show the same elements:
profile system and depth;
glazing composition;
hardware brand and type;
whether installation and clean-up are included;
warranty on the product and on installation;
production lead time and quote validity;
whether the price is final.

What may not be included
Generally not included are the costs of structural demolition or civil works outside the scope of installation, client-supplied materials, and customs duties where applicable. At Apex Frames these are listed separately in the quote.

How to get an accurate quote
An accurate price only comes after measurement. The process: contact, site visit and measurement, a detailed quote within 48 hours, valid for 30 days. The price in the quote is final, with no hidden costs.

Mistakes when comparing quotes
Quotes with different profile systems or glazing, compared as if equal.
One quote includes installation and another doesn’t.
A price without documentation (DoP, CE) or written warranty.
Quotes with no validity period or lead time.
Apex Frames provides the quote in writing, with a final price, specifications, lead time and payment terms, within 48 hours of the technical visit.

Frequently asked questions
Why are there no prices on the website?
Price depends on dimensions, system, glazing and hardware, so we give it only in a written quote after measurement.
How long is a quote valid?
A quote is valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
Is the price final?
Yes. Prices in the quote are final, with no hidden costs. Apex Frames is not VAT-registered.
What if I change something after the quote?
Every change is documented by a contract addendum; verbal changes are not accepted.
Do you provide quotes in English or Italian?
Yes, on request we prepare quotes in English or Italian, priced in EUR.

## Double or Triple Glazing? Argon, Low-E and How to Choose | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/double-or-triple-glazing/

Home
Blog
Double or Triple Glazing? Argon, Low-E and How to Choose

Glazing

Double or Triple Glazing? Argon, Low-E and How to Choose

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Double glazing with argon gas and a Low-E coating is often enough for homes. Triple glazing insulates better but is heavier and costs more, so it makes sense for very cold rooms or when maximum insulation is required. The exact value always comes from the Declaration of Performance.

In this article
How double glazing is built
What argon and Low-E do
When triple glazing is worth it
Other glass types to know
How to read Ug and Uw
Which glass for which room
Frequently asked questions

How double glazing is built
Double glazing has two panes separated by a sealed, gas-filled space. The notation 4-16-4 means 4 mm glass, 16 mm gap, 4 mm glass. Triple glazing adds a third pane and a second gap (e.g. 4-16-4-16-4).

What argon and Low-E do
Argon gas in the gap reduces heat transfer compared with air.
A Low-E coating is a very thin, invisible layer that reflects part of the heat, reducing winter heat loss.

When triple glazing is worth it
It makes sense when maximum insulation is required, in very cold rooms or in high-noise locations. Keep in mind it is heavier and thicker, so the profile and hardware must be suitable.

Other glass types to know
Laminated (triplex): safety glass that holds fragments if broken.
Tempered: stronger, for doors and balustrades.
Acoustic: for noisy streets.
Solar control (stop-sol): for south-facing exposure.

How to read Ug and Uw
Ug refers to the glass only, while Uw refers to the whole window (frame + glass). The lower the value, the less heat is lost. Compare only values taken from the Declaration of Performance.

Which glass for which room
Bedroom on a noisy street: acoustic glass.
South facade with strong sun: solar-control (stop-sol) glass.
Very cold rooms or high insulation needs: triple glazing.
Balconies and doors: tempered or laminated glass, for safety.

Frequently asked questions
What does 4-16-4 mean?
Two 4 mm panes separated by a 16 mm gas-filled gap.
Is triple glazing very heavy?
It is heavier than double, so the frame and hardware must suit the weight.
Can I fit triple glazing in existing windows?
It depends on the profile and hardware, which must carry the extra weight; we assess it during the technical visit.
What is argon gas?
An inert gas in the gap between the panes that reduces heat transfer compared with air.

## Why Do Windows Sweat? Condensation and How to Fix It | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/window-condensation/

Home
Blog
Why Do Windows Sweat? Condensation and How to Fix It

Advice

Why Do Windows Sweat? Condensation and How to Fix It

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Condensation forms when warm, humid air meets a cold surface. It is usually not a defect but a sign of high humidity or insufficient ventilation. A better window lowers the risk, but ventilation remains essential.

In this article
Why it happens
What you can do right away
When the window is the cause
What to look for when replacing
Myths and facts
Frequently asked questions

Why it happens
Indoor air carries water vapour from cooking, washing, drying clothes and breathing. When it meets cold glass or frames, the vapour condenses into droplets. The colder the surface and the higher the humidity, the more condensation.

What you can do right away
Ventilate for a few minutes with windows wide open, rather than leaving them slightly open for hours.
Use the extractor fan when cooking or washing.
Don’t dry laundry indoors without ventilation.
Keep indoor humidity moderate; roughly 40–60% is commonly recommended.

When the window is the cause
Persistent condensation can indicate old windows with poor insulation, damaged seals or installation without good perimeter insulation. New windows with good glazing keep the inner surface warmer, so condensation drops. Light external condensation on cold, clear mornings can occur even with highly insulating glass and is not a defect.

What to look for when replacing
suitable glazing (double or triple, Low-E);
installation with PU perimeter insulation and quality silicone sealing;
a ventilation plan for the home.

Myths and facts
Myth: condensation means the window is faulty. Fact: it usually signals high humidity or insufficient ventilation.
Myth: new windows don’t need ventilation. Fact: a better window lowers the risk, but regular ventilation remains essential.

Frequently asked questions
Is condensation a window defect?
In most cases no: it results from humidity and temperature. If it is persistent, insulation, sealing and installation should be checked.
Do new windows solve condensation?
They reduce the risk but do not replace regular ventilation.
What humidity is normal at home?
Roughly 40–60% is commonly recommended. Above that, condensation risk rises.
Why does condensation appear only in the window corners?
The corners and frame are the coldest parts of the window. Persistent condensation there can indicate thermal bridges or installation without good perimeter insulation.

## DoP and CE Marking for Windows: How to Read Them | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/declaration-of-performance-ce-marking/

Home
Blog
Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE Marking: How to Read Them

Standards and documents

Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE Marking: How to Read Them

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer The Declaration of Performance (DoP) is the manufacturer’s document stating a window’s or door’s certified values, under EN 14351-1 and Regulation (EU) 305/2011. The CE marking shows the manufacturer takes responsibility for those values. Ask for both before ordering.

In this article
What DoP and CE are
What values it contains
How to use it
Which documents you get from Apex Frames
Common mistakes with documents
Frequently asked questions

What DoP and CE are
The European standard EN 14351-1 sets requirements for external pedestrian doors and windows. The manufacturer issues a Declaration of Performance with the product values and affixes the CE marking under Regulation (EU) No 305/2011.

What values it contains
It typically includes, among others:
Uw: thermal transmittance of the window;
Rw: sound insulation;
air permeability;
water tightness;
resistance to wind load.

How to use it
Compare only values from the DoP, not from brochures or verbal promises.
Make sure the document refers to the system and configuration you are ordering.
For projects with an architect or institutions, the document is often used for specification.

Which documents you get from Apex Frames
At handover you receive the manufacturer’s DoP and CE marking, the warranty certificate and the maintenance guide, together with the handover protocol.

Common mistakes with documents
The document doesn’t refer to the system and configuration you are ordering.
Confusing the Ug value (glass only) with Uw (the whole window).
Accepting verbal promises instead of a written document.

Frequently asked questions
Does Apex Frames provide a DoP?
Yes. Products come with the manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance and CE marking, and you can request them at quote stage.
What is Uw?
The thermal transmittance coefficient of the whole window. The lower the value, the less heat is lost.
Who issues the Declaration of Performance?
The system manufacturer issues the DoP and affixes the CE marking, under EN 14351-1 and Regulation (EU) 305/2011.
Where do I get the DoP for my order?
You can request it at quote stage; at handover you receive it with the warranty certificate and the maintenance guide.

Choosing products

Strap or Motorised Shutters? Outside or Inside Box

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Strap-operated shutters are the simple, economical choice; motorised shutters with remote control are more comfortable, especially for large openings. An outside box allows quick installation and easy access, while an inside box gives a cleaner look and better integration into the facade.

In this article
Strap or motor
Outside or inside box
What to ask before ordering
Common mistakes
Frequently asked questions

Strap or motor
Criteria Strap-operated Motorised

Operation Manual, with a strap With a remote control

Large openings Less practical Suitable, with reinforcement parts for large sizes

Material PVC or aluminium Fits uPVC and aluminium windows

Installation Quick Motor selected by weight and size

Cost Economical Usually higher

Outside or inside box
Outside box: ideal for quick installation and easy access.
Inside box: a cleaner look and better aesthetic integration into the facade.
The choice is made before measurement, because the box affects the facade’s appearance and the available space.

What to ask before ordering
Does the shutter fit your window (uPVC or aluminium)?
Which colour matches the window or door profile?
For motorised shutters: which motor is selected for the weight and size?
Do you receive a user guide for the remote control at handover?

Common mistakes
Choosing a motor without accounting for the shutter’s weight and size.
Deciding the box type (outside or inside) after measurement, when it is too late.
A shutter colour that doesn’t match the window or door profile.
Forgetting the remote-control guide at handover.

Frequently asked questions
Do shutters fit existing windows?
Shutters fit uPVC and aluminium windows; we confirm compatibility during the technical visit.
Do I get a guide for the remote?
Yes, for motorised shutters we provide a remote-control user guide at handover.
Do louvred shutters have slats?
Yes, aluminium louvred shutters have slats, fixed or opening.
Are external roller blinds available too?
Yes, we offer external roller blinds, manual or motorised.

## Window Installation in 8 Steps | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/window-installation-8-steps/

Home
Blog
Window Installation in 8 Steps: What to Ask Your Installer

Installation

Window Installation in 8 Steps: What to Ask Your Installer

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 5 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer A good installation follows 8 steps: preliminary inspection, removal, frame fixing, PU perimeter insulation, airtight sealing, mechanical adjustment, final inspection and clean-up. Even the best window performs poorly if badly installed.

In this article
The 8-step procedure
Client checklist
Handover and warranty
What can go wrong
Frequently asked questions

The 8-step procedure
Preliminary inspection: dimensions, plans and the condition of the supporting structure are verified.
Removal (if applicable): careful removal of the existing product and clean-up of the opening.
Frame fixing per the manufacturer’s specifications and EN 14351-1.
Perimeter insulation with polyurethane (PU) foam, inside and out.
Airtight sealing with quality silicone, neutral or acetic depending on the surface.
Mechanical adjustment: checking and calibrating mechanisms, hinges and tracks.
Final inspection: visual, functional and thermal check of every unit.
Site clean-up: removal of materials and waste from the site.

Client checklist
Were measurements taken on site and have you approved the specification sheet?
Are removal and clean-up included in the quote?
Is perimeter insulation and sealing used on both sides?
Are all openings and locks tested before handover?
Do you receive a handover protocol and warranty certificate?

Handover and warranty
After the final inspection, both parties sign the handover protocol. The warranty starts from that date: 5 years on the product and 24 months on installation.

What can go wrong
Without good perimeter insulation: cold and condensation around the frame.
Weak silicone: water and air ingress.
Insufficient mechanism adjustment: windows that close badly.
Inaccurate measurements: a window that doesn’t fit the opening.

Frequently asked questions
What happens to the existing windows?
They are carefully removed and the opening is cleaned before the new product is installed. You can request removal as part of the quote.
Do you install products bought elsewhere?
Yes. We also offer installation, removal or sealing as a standalone service when the client supplies the product.
What is checked at handover?
A visual, functional and thermal check of every unit; then both parties sign the handover protocol.
When does the installation warranty start?
The installation warranty (24 months) starts from the date of the handover protocol.

## Sliding Doors: Types and How to Choose | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/sliding-doors-types-and-how-to-choose/

Home
Blog
Sliding Doors: Lift & Slide, PSK or Standard?

Choosing products

Sliding Doors: Lift & Slide, PSK or Standard?

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 5 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Lift & slide doors suit large openings and comfortable daily use; standard sliding doors are the simplest solution; PSK combines tilt ventilation with parallel sliding; folding (bi-fold) doors open almost the full width. The choice depends on size, space at the side and budget.

In this article
The main types
How to choose
What is checked at the technical visit
Common mistakes
Frequently asked questions

The main types
Type How it opens Best for

Lift & slide (Hebeschiebe) The leaf lifts slightly and slides; when closed it lowers onto the seals Large openings, frequent use

Standard sliding The leaf slides on tracks Balconies and simple openings

Parallel-slide-tilt (PSK) The leaf tilts, then slides parallel in front of the fixed part When you want ventilation and sliding in one door

Folding (bi-fold), aluminium Leaves fold over one another Very wide openings, indoor-outdoor connection

How to choose
Opening width: very wide openings usually call for lift & slide, panoramic or aluminium folding systems.
Space to the side: sliding leaves need somewhere to stop.
Profile and colour: uPVC or aluminium; see how to choose the colour .
Glass: double or triple, tempered or laminated for safety.
Insect screens: sliding and pleated (plissé) models are available for doors.

What is checked at the technical visit
Our technical team verifies dimensions, plans and the condition of the supporting structure, then prepares the specification sheet, which you approve before production. For large doors, these measurements determine which system is feasible.

Common mistakes
Overlooking the space to the side for the sliding leaves.
Choosing a system without measurement and an approved specification sheet.
Forgetting the insect screen when planning.
Non-safety glass in large doors: choose tempered or laminated.

Frequently asked questions
Which sliding door is best for a balcony?
Balconies usually get a standard sliding or lift & slide door, depending on opening width and budget. We can assess it during the technical visit.
Can I add an insect screen to a sliding door?
Yes. We offer horizontal sliding screens and pleated (plissé) screens for doors and windows.
How wide can a sliding door be?
It depends on the system. Very wide openings are usually solved with lift & slide, panoramic or folding systems; the exact width is specified after measurement.
Can sliding doors have tempered glass?
Yes. Tempered or laminated glass is chosen for safety, according to the building and your requirements.

## How to Choose an Entrance Door | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/how-to-choose-an-entrance-door/

Home
Blog
How to Choose an Entrance Door: uPVC, Aluminium, Panel or Automatic

Choosing products

How to Choose an Entrance Door: uPVC, Aluminium, Panel or Automatic

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Choose an entrance door by use: uPVC or aluminium for homes and businesses, a solid panel for privacy and safety glass for light. For busy business entrances, an automatic sensor door is more practical. Define left or right opening from the outside before ordering.

In this article
Five decisions before ordering
Automatic doors for businesses
What to ask your supplier
Checklist before ordering
Frequently asked questions

Five decisions before ordering
Material: uPVC or aluminium; aluminium is used for heavy loads and high traffic.
Panel or glass: PVC panel doors (e.g. anthracite), made to size, or with glazed parts; browse the catalogue of models .
Safety glass: laminated (triplex) or tempered; see the difference between them .
Opening: left or right, defined from outside; each leaf of a double door can open differently.
Locks, handles and hardware to suit the building.

Automatic doors for businesses
For shop, clinic and public-building entrances we offer automatic doors with a sensor (photocell) and a professional automation system. The door opens by itself as a person approaches, with no touch needed.

What to ask your supplier
the manufacturer’s Declaration of Performance (DoP) and CE marking;
the specification sheet with the opening confirmed before production;
the warranty: 5 years on the product and 24 months on installation;
the handover protocol after installation.

Checklist before ordering
Measurements were taken on site.
Left or right opening is confirmed from outside.
You have chosen the panel or glass and the colour.
The safety glass is defined (laminated or tempered).
Locks, handles and hardware are in the specification.
You have requested the DoP, CE marking and written warranty.

Frequently asked questions
How is left or right opening defined?
It is defined by looking at the door from outside, and we confirm it on the specification sheet before manufacture.
Can the door have a glass side panel?
Yes, configurations with a glass side panel and a panel leaf are made to order and defined in the specification.
Can I order a door in a special size?
Yes. PVC panel doors are made to size, confirmed on the specification sheet.
Do you offer doors for business entrances?
Yes. We offer PVC and aluminium entrance doors, and automatic sensor doors for businesses and public buildings.

## What Is a Thermal Break in Aluminium? | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/what-is-a-thermal-break/

Home
Blog
What Is a Thermal Break in Aluminium Profiles?

Standards and documents

What Is a Thermal Break in Aluminium Profiles?

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer A thermal break is an insulating separator inside the aluminium profile that interrupts heat flow from inside to outside and vice versa. Aluminium conducts heat well, so profiles without this separator lose energy quickly. The exact insulation value always comes from Uw in the Declaration of Performance.

In this article
How it works
Why it matters
When plain aluminium is enough
How to verify
How to compare two aluminium windows
Frequently asked questions

How it works
The profile is split into two aluminium parts, an inner and an outer one, joined by an insulating element with low conductivity. This break stops heat from passing straight through the metal, reducing the thermal bridge in the frame.

Why it matters
Better insulation than plain aluminium.
Lower condensation risk on the frame: see why windows sweat .
More comfort , because the inner frame doesn’t get as cold or as hot.

When plain aluminium is enough
Plain aluminium (without a thermal break) is used for fixed panels and partitions, including mirrored double glazing. For windows, balcony doors and entrance doors that separate the heated space from the outside, thermally broken aluminium is chosen.

How to verify
ask for the Uw value in the system’s Declaration of Performance;
compare the system and glass being offered, not just the profile;
ask for installation with perimeter insulation: see installation in 8 steps .

How to compare two aluminium windows
Compare the Uw from each system’s DoP.
Compare the glass included in the quote.
Ask about the system depth and whether the profile has a thermal break.
Ask about installation : perimeter insulation determines the real result.

Frequently asked questions
Is thermally broken aluminium suitable for winter?
Yes, when the system and glass are chosen well and installation is good. Concrete values are given in the Declaration of Performance.
How does it differ from uPVC?
Both can insulate well; aluminium allows slimmer profiles and larger openings. Read our detailed uPVC vs aluminium comparison.
Can you see the thermal break from outside?
No. It shows only in the profile cross-section and in the Uw value of the Declaration of Performance.
Do facades have a thermal break?
Curtain wall facades are insulated aluminium structures, according to the selected system.

Related

Thermally broken aluminium
Glass facades

## Laminated or Tempered Glass | Apex Frames
URL: https://www.apexframes.co/en/blog/laminated-or-tempered-glass/

Home
Blog
Laminated or Tempered Glass? Which Is Safer

Glazing

Laminated or Tempered Glass? Which Is Safer

By the Apex Frames team · October 31, 2026 · 4 min read

Illustrative image

Short answer Laminated (triplex) glass has an interlayer between panes and holds fragments together if broken. Tempered glass is more impact-resistant and, when it breaks, turns into small pieces. For doors and balustrades one is chosen according to risk, and often both are combined when extra safety is required.

In this article
Comparison
What to know before ordering
Where it is used at Apex Frames
Common mistakes
Frequently asked questions

Comparison
Criteria Laminated (triplex) Tempered

How it’s made Two or more panes bonded with an interlayer Glass heat-treated after cutting

When it breaks Fragments stay bonded to the interlayer Breaks into small pieces

Strength Stays in place even after breaking Higher impact resistance

Typical use Doors, windows, balustrades, facades Doors and balustrades

What to know before ordering
Tempered glass cannot be cut after tempering. Dimensions must be exact before production: one more reason for on-site measurement and an approved specification sheet.
For doors, balustrades and balconies ask your designer or architect which type the project requires.
Combinations with acoustic, Low-E or solar-control glass depend on the system: see double or triple glazing .

Where it is used at Apex Frames
Laminated and tempered glass is used in entrance doors, sliding doors, facades and safety-glass balustrades. Railings and balustrades are made to on-site measurements and the architectural design: see stainless, aluminium and glass railings .

Common mistakes
Ordering tempered glass without exact measurements, since it can no longer be cut.
Assuming every glass is safety glass.
Ignoring project and building-rule requirements for doors and balustrades.

Frequently asked questions
How can I tell tempered glass from ordinary glass?
It usually carries an etched mark in a corner from the manufacturer. Look for it in the order documentation.
Can tempered glass be cut on site?
No. After tempering, glass cannot be cut, so measurements must be accurate before ordering.
Is tempered glass safer than laminated?
There is no single answer: tempered is more impact-resistant, while laminated holds fragments together; they are often combined.
Can laminated glass be used on a balcony?
Yes, the type is chosen according to the project and building rules; ask your designer.

Related

Glazing
Entrance & automatic doors
Stainless, aluminium & glass railings
